# json-flatten

> Flatten nested JSON records into relational tables: dotted columns for objects, child tables with parent keys for arrays, deterministic column order and RFC 4180 CSV output Python package `trysac-json-flatten`, import name `json_flatten`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
